verdict.rationale: Check documents that it handles tax calculation, money movement, and tax form production and filing. It also documents workplaces as a payroll object and withholding setup during employee onboarding, all of which underpin per-location payroll taxes. However, none of the evidence explicitly addresses employees across multiple states, state tax registrations, or state-specific withholding rules. Missing for 10: explicit multi-state payroll documentation, state tax registration/account setup, per-state withholding handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
